images.title: The 12 edges of a box
images.purpose: Show the concept's box with its 12 edges coloured in three groups of 4, and the count of the sides of all faces halved written below, so that the edges can be counted without missing one or counting one twice.
images.composition: One box as a wire frame on the left with its edges coloured top, bottom and standing, a colour key on the right and the counting line across the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. One box (a matchbox shape) drawn as a wire frame on the left of the frame, with white faces and no vertex dots. Corner points: front bottom left (250, 600), front bottom right (610, 600), front top right (610, 360), front top left (250, 360), back top left (400, 250), back top right (760, 250), back bottom right (760, 490), back bottom left (400, 490). EDGES, exactly 12 straight lines (7 px), coloured in 3 groups. 4 teal #0072B2 edges round the top face: (250, 360) to (610, 360), (610, 360) to (760, 250), (760, 250) to (400, 250), (400, 250) to (250, 360). 4 amber #E69F00 edges round the bottom face: (250, 600) to (610, 600), (610, 600) to (760, 490), (760, 490) to (400, 490) dashed, (400, 490) to (250, 600) dashed. 4 reddish purple #CC79A7 edges standing up between the top and the bottom: (250, 600) to (250, 360), (610, 600) to (610, 360), (760, 490) to (760, 250), (400, 490) to (400, 250) dashed. The 3 dashed lines (dash 14 px, gap 10 px) are the hidden edges; the other 9 are solid. LEGEND on the right: three line samples (70 px long, 7 px thick) at x 880 to 950, each with its words (38 px, dark #1F2937) starting at x 970: a teal sample at y 250 with the words top: 4 edges; an amber sample at y 330 with the words bottom: 4 edges; a reddish purple sample at y 410 with the words standing: 4 edges. Across the bottom, centred at (728, 730): one line of bold dark text, 6 × 4 = 24 sides, 24 ÷ 2 = 12 edges (58 px). In all: 12 edges (4 teal, 4 amber, 4 reddish purple), 3 legend rows and 1 line of text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any count of edges or legend rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
an edge in a colour other than the one stated, or a hidden edge drawn solid
vertex dots or numbers on the box
images.takeaway: A box has 6 faces with 4 sides each, 24 sides in all, and every edge is a side of 2 faces, so it has 24 ÷ 2 = 12 edges.
images.description: A box drawn as a wire frame with 4 top edges in teal, 4 bottom edges in amber and 4 standing edges in reddish purple, with the line 6 × 4 = 24 sides, 24 ÷ 2 = 12 edges.
images.context: Concept image for Counting the Edges of a Solid. It shows the concept's own box and not a figure from your maths book.
images.teaching_notes: Let the child trace each colour and count its 4 edges, then compare 4 + 4 + 4 with the halved count of sides. The slip to watch is stopping at 24 and counting every edge twice.

image_decisions.why: The box with its 12 edges coloured in three groups of 4 is the mathematics: the child counts the edges once each and meets the halved count of sides.
